title: Visa TAP: browse a product, then check out with signed objects
summary: One shopping trip under TAP. The agent signs a browsing request with agent-browser-auth, a CDN verifies it against the Visa key store, and the merchant serves the page. At checkout the agent signs with agent-payer-auth and adds the consumer recognition object and the payment container, both signed with the same key and nonce. The merchant verifies them, decrypts the payment payload and authorizes the payment through its acquirer as an ordinary card payment.

steps.label: GET product page, signed agent-browser-auth
steps.detail: The agent requests a product detail page. Signature-Input covers @authority and @path and carries created, expires, keyid, alg, nonce and tag. The values here are placeholders.

payload.content:
GET /example-product HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225600;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767225900;nonce="bm9uY2UtcGxhY2Vob2xkZXI";tag="agent-browser-auth"
Signature: sig2=:c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

specRef.section: Agent Recognition Signature; Sample Browsing Request

failures.condition: A Checkout Enabler strips the signature headers
failures.outcome: The request arrives unsigned and is treated as an unknown bot

steps.label: Fetch the key for keyid (if not cached)
steps.detail: The CDN looks up the public key by keyid in its cache or retrieves the JWKS from Visa's well-known URL.

steps.label: Check tag, fields, window, nonce, signature
steps.detail: The CDN checks the tag, the minimum fields, that created is past, expires is future and the two are at most 8 minutes apart, that the nonce is new (if it keeps a record), and verifies the signature over the rebuilt signature base.

failures.outcome: Not a trusted agent; block or use other means

failures.condition: Missing field, bad window, reused nonce or bad signature

steps.label: Forward as a verified agent request
steps.detail: The CDN passes the request to the merchant, marked as a trusted agent that is browsing. The merchant may still limit what the agent can do.

specRef.section: Cloudflare will run the following checks

steps.label: 200 product page
steps.detail: The merchant answers with product details, availability and final cost, possibly in a simpler agent-specific page.

steps.label: POST checkout, signed agent-payer-auth, with body objects
steps.detail: The agent signs the checkout request with the payer tag and puts agenticConsumer and agenticPaymentContainer in the body, signed with the same key and the same nonce. The header signature does not cover the body.

specRef.section: Sample Checkout Request; Consumer Recognition; Payment

failures.outcome: The header signature still verifies; only the object signatures can catch it

steps.label: Verify header signature, forward
steps.detail: The CDN repeats the header checks with the agent-payer-auth tag and forwards the request.

specRef.section: Cloudflare will run the following checks

steps.label: Verify agenticConsumer and agenticPaymentContainer
steps.detail: For each object the merchant checks required fields, compares the nonce with the header nonce, locates the key for kid and verifies the signature over the other fields in the order received.

failures.outcome: Content may be inaccurate; the merchant may still use it
Should not be used for payment

steps.label: Decrypt payload and map the ID Token
steps.detail: The merchant decrypts the payment payload with its private key and may map the obfuscated email or phone in the ID Token to an existing account.

specRef.section: Processing of Payment Data; ID Token

steps.label: Authorize the card payment
steps.detail: The merchant authorizes the token through its acquirer as for any card-not-present payment. TAP specifies nothing in this step.

failures.outcome: Ordinary card decline; TAP has no role

steps.label: Order confirmation
steps.detail: The merchant returns the checkout result to the agent.
